methodology.title: 2.1 Core Principle: The "Because" Bridge (Cây cầu "Because")
content: Problem: Students can say "I was scared," but they often struggle to develop longer sentences to explain the reason, or they use the incorrect tense in the causal clause.

Solution: Introduce the "Because Bridge" concept. This bridge connects a past Emotion to a past Reason. Structure: [Subject] + was/were + [Emotion] + BECAUSE + [Past Clause]. The teacher uses TPR (Total Physical Response): demonstrating the emotion with facial expressions or gestures (e.g., holding the stomach to feign hunger), creating a bridge shape with both hands when saying "because," and then acting out the reason (e.g., shaking the head and pointing to the mouth to show "I didn't eat").
